title: SpaceX's Grok Build AI coding agent exposed sensitive user data through security vulnerability
summary: A vulnerability in SpaceX's Grok Build exposed sensitive data through discoverable shareable links. SpaceX leaked onboarding plans, sales maps, advertising proposals, and playbooks; exposure also affected hospitals, fire departments, and Fortune 500 companies.
takeaways: Grok Build links used randomized four-word phrases but positioned entropy left of domain (discoverable via DNS)
SpaceX leaked: onboarding plans, 594-account sales territory map, 8 X advertising proposals, brand playbooks
Exposure affected 6 Fortune 500 companies and 26 organizations with 1,000+ employees
Only 1 of exposed apps required password; ~2% of material rated high/critical severity

title: Google Accelerates AI Performance by Removing Python from Query Pipeline
summary: Google open-sourced XSE (XLA Serving Engine), which handles over six million queries per second for Search, Ads, and YouTube Shorts without Python in its serving pipeline. The C++ runtime delivers 2–5x throughput of optimized Python servers while using a quarter of the memory.
takeaways: XSE handles 6+ million queries per second across Search, Ads, YouTube Shorts
2–5x throughput improvement vs. optimized Python; quarter the memory usage
Workflow: Python/JAX model code exported via StableHLO to C++ runtime with XLA compilation
Integration with TorchTPU planned for PyTorch users
